Calculation Details

MetricValueNote

How it works

Estimate basic hemispherical dome area and volume from diameter. Use the units shown in the calculator and review every assumption before using the result.

Formula

Radius = diameter ÷ 2; hemisphere area = 2πr²; volume = 2/3πr³.

Worked example

Try multiple diameters to compare material area and interior volume.

Important assumptions

This tool is designed for planning and comparison. Real-world prices, manufacturer ratings, building requirements, lender terms, electrical codes, tolerances, and product specifications can vary.
